Members

(module scope)

Kind-specific wasm surface for the burn crate — typed on top of the generic WasmWidget so calls stay checked.

packLetters

Packs the session's letter table into the crate's flat layout — 6 f32s per glyph: x0, y0, x1, y1 (paper device px), v (speed multiplier), delay (ignition fraction). Mirrors sim::BurnSim::set_letters field-for-field.

  • @param s The live session — letters were filled by analyzePaper.
  • @returns Flat letter table, or null when analysis produced none.

packColors

Packs the burn inks into the crate's [core, mid, edge, scorch, smoke] × rgba table. parseCssColor yields 0..1 rgb triples; alpha is 1 — the JS sim paints particles fully opaque and fades via globalAlpha, which the crate folds into the emitted tint instead.

  • @param s The live session — ink was resolved by readBurnInk.
  • @returns 20 f32s for set_colors.

pushBurnSession

Pushes the session's static tables into a freshly mounted widget — begin() creates the sim (dir + paper origin + deterministic seed), then letters/ink/colors land once. Called from the mount callback after the artifact's init has resolved.

  • @param s The live session.

frameBurnWasm

Per-frame wasm arm — pushes direction, stage + jagged amplitude and ticks the sim once. set_dir clears live particles inside the crate (a flip restarts the mote stream), so it is only forwarded when the session's dir actually changed.

  • @param s The live session.
  • @param stage Global burn stage 0..1 (climbs in both directions).
  • @param jagAmp Jagged-edge amplitude in device px.
  • @param dt Seconds since the previous frame.

liveBurnParticles

The loop's settle check for the wasm path — the session idles once the front is spent AND the crate's last mote died (mirroring the JS particles.length === 0 condition).

  • @param s The live session.
  • @returns Live particle count in the crate's sim.

tryWasmBurn

Attempts the wasm mount: creates the stacked particle canvas (same class/box as the paper canvas — it paints above it by DOM order) and mounts the burn artifact on it with MANUAL drive — this module keeps the session's own RAF loop, so the bridge only initializes the surface. On any failure the 2D particle path simply keeps running.

  • @param s The live session — must already be laid out (syncPaper ran).

setBurnDirWasm

Pushes a dir flip into the crate (burn ↔ rebuild) when mounted.

mirrorBurnGpuCanvas

Mirrors the paper canvas's CSS box onto the particle canvas.

destroyBurnWasm

Releases the wasm handle + removes the particle canvas — teardown path only; a pending mount drops its canvas when it resolves.

  • @param s The session being torn down.
